symptom: `check -p --references` reported CE5400 for an `export level api` microflow exposing a Hidden entity of a Protected (add-on) module and told the user to fix it in Studio Pro: `create persistent entity Shop.Order (…) export level api` was "extraneous input 'export' expecting the start of a statement", and attributes, associations and enumerations had no clause either (mendixlabs/mxcli#1498, kris-bom's point 2). check also missed CE5400 for a Hidden ENUMERATION parameter, which mxbuild reports the same way.
cause: Only microflows, nanoflows and workflows had an EXPORT LEVEL clause. entityToGen/attributeToGen/assocToGen/crossAssocToGen/enumToGen wrote the "Hidden" constant and the #801 carry wrote the stored level back over the rebuild unconditionally, so even a semantic model holding API could not reach storage. validateProtectedModuleRefs judged entities only, from stored levels and a 'script-created = Hidden' bool.
fix: `export level api|hidden` (the microflow clause) on create entity / view entity / each attribute / create association / create enumeration, `set export level` on alter entity / association / enumeration and on modify attribute; absent keeps the stored level. Converters write orDefault(level, "Hidden"); the entity, attribute, association and cross-association carries and keepStoredExportLevelUnlessSet stand down for an authored level; reads fill Attribute/Association/CrossModuleAssociation/Enumeration.ExportLevel; describe prints `export level api`, omitting Hidden. The validator takes a level stated anywhere in the script over the stored one and checks enumerations for CE5400; its hints name the alter statement. Gated at 9.3.0 (domain_model.export_levels).
insight: A carry added to stop a rewrite resetting a property (#801: ExportLevel back to Hidden) silently becomes the reason the property can never be authored: once there is a spelling, every carry of it must stand down for an authored value, and each one is a separate site (entity, attribute in two rebuild paths, association, cross-association patch, enumeration unit). A test that sets only Hidden over a stored API cannot tell an honoured clause from the carry, and only API over a stored Hidden cannot tell it from the constant — run both. Measure attributes and associations too before scoping a 'level' feature to entities: on 11.14.0 another module changing a Hidden attribute or retrieving over a Hidden association is CE1406 on its own, and CE1406 masks CE5400 in one mx check, so measure each rule in a copy without the other. check still does not predict the attribute/association CE1406.
